dialogues.jp: うるさいヤツに出会ってしまった。
dialogues.en: I bumped into the noisy one.
dialogues.text: I bumped into the noisy one.

dialogues.jp:
と言っても、杉並ではない。あいつは『うるさ
いヤツ』ではなく『面倒くさいヤツ』だ。
dialogues.en:
I'm not talking about Suginami, actually. He's not the
"noisy" one, he's the "troublesome" one.
dialogues.text:
I'm not talking about Suginami, actually. He's not the
"noisy" one, he's the "troublesome" one.

dialogues.jp:
『うるさいヤツ』ってのは、何にでも首を突っ
込みたがり、こっちのことなどお構いなしに喋
りたてるヤツだ。
dialogues.en:
The "noisy" one simply likes to talk about everything and
anything without a care in the world.
dialogues.text:
The "noisy" one simply likes to talk about everything and
anything without a care in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、今日はどうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Senpai, what happened?"
dialogues.text: "Senpai, what happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……なんでもないよ」
dialogues.en: "...Nothing."
dialogues.text: "...Nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、音夢先輩から、朝倉先輩は、課題も
　何にもなくって家でごろごろしてるって聞い
　てたんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"But I heard from Nemu-senpai that Asakura-senpai has just
been lazing around at home during this preparation period!"
dialogues.text:
"But I heard from Nemu-senpai that Asakura-senpai has just
been lazing around at home during this preparation period!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まだ卒業した訳じゃないんだ。学校に来たっ
　ていいだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"It's nothing to do with the graduation. There's nothing
wrong with me going to school, is there?"
dialogues.text:
"It's nothing to do with the graduation. There's nothing
wrong with me going to school, is there?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ、そうですけど……」
dialogues.en: "Well, no, but..."
dialogues.text: "Well, no, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、いいだろ。俺は急ぐんだ」
dialogues.en: "Then it's fine. Now if you'd excuse me, I'm in a rush."
dialogues.text: "Then it's fine. Now if you'd excuse me, I'm in a rush."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、月城さんのところですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going to meet Tsukishiro-san?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going to meet Tsukishiro-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Ha? Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ha? Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、今、先輩、ドキッとしたでしょ。もしか
　して、当たりですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, senpai just got shocked by that. I got it right?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, senpai just got shocked by that. I got it right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「べ、別にそんなんじゃない」
dialogues.en: "I, it's not like that."
dialogues.text: "I, it's not like that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、別に隠すことはないじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "No, it's nothing you need to hide!"
dialogues.text: "No, it's nothing you need to hide!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……違うっての」
dialogues.en: "...You're getting it wrong."
dialogues.text: "...You're getting it wrong."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そう言ってそっぽを向き、すたすたと歩
き出す。
dialogues.en:
Muttering that under my breath, I quickened my pace towards
school.
dialogues.text:
Muttering that under my breath, I quickened my pace towards
school.

dialogues.jp: その後を、美春がついてくる。
dialogues.en: Behind me, Miharu started following me as well.
dialogues.text: Behind me, Miharu started following me as well.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで、ついてくるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why are you following me for?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you following me for?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「――だって、美春もそっちに用事があるんで
　すもん」
dialogues.en: "--Because I have things to do, too."
dialogues.text: "--Because I have things to do, too."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "Like?"
dialogues.text: "Like?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春も、月城さんに会いに行くんですよぅ」
dialogues.en: "I want to go see Tsukishiro-san as well!"
dialogues.text: "I want to go see Tsukishiro-san as well!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……勝手にしろ」
dialogues.en: "...Do what you want."
dialogues.text: "...Do what you want."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、ほら。友達になりたいじゃないです
　か。せっかく知り合ったんだし」
dialogues.en:
"After all, I want to be her friend. I should see her every
so often too!"
dialogues.text:
"After all, I want to be her friend. I should see her every
so often too!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "I suppose."
dialogues.text: "I suppose."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩だってそう思ってるから、会いに行くん
　じゃないんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Isn't that the reason why you're going there as well,
senpai?"
dialogues.text:
"Isn't that the reason why you're going there as well,
senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「俺はそんな」
dialogues.en: "I don't..."
dialogues.text: "I don't..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さんカワイイですからねぇ。それにあの
　なんだか不思議な感じは、誰でも惹かれちゃ
　いますよねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-san is so cute as well. With that and her
mysterious charm, anyone would be attracted to her!"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-san is so cute as well. With that and her
mysterious charm, anyone would be attracted to her!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「コホン。……どうだか」
dialogues.en: "Ahem. ...I'm going ahead."
dialogues.text: "Ahem. ...I'm going ahead."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そんな美春を放っておいて、すたすたと
歩みを進める。
dialogues.en: I ignored her, quickening my pace even further.
dialogues.text: I ignored her, quickening my pace even further.

dialogues.jp: 「相変わらず、ここにいるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You're here as usual, huh."
dialogues.text: "You're here as usual, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.jp:
月城がきょとんとした顔で、体育館裏に現れた
俺の顔を見る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's slightly surprised face turned to look at mine,
behind the gym.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's slightly surprised face turned to look at mine,
behind the gym.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「こんちわ、月城さん」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon, Tsukishiro-san."
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon, Tsukishiro-san."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……天枷、さん」
dialogues.en: "...Amakase, san."
dialogues.text: "...Amakase, san."

dialogues.jp:
後ろから美春がひょっこりと顔を出し、軽く手
を振る。
dialogues.en: Behind me, Miharu's face popped out, with a little wave.
dialogues.text: Behind me, Miharu's face popped out, with a little wave.

dialogues.jp: 「調子はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "How's it doing?"
dialogues.text: "How's it doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、もぞもぞと手袋を外し、いつものよう
に人形を触る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro squirmed her gloves off, and as usual, started
rubbing her doll.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro squirmed her gloves off, and as usual, started
rubbing her doll.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うーん、あまり変わらないよ。肥料やったり
　もしたけど、ほんの少ししか効果がないみた
　い」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, it hasn't changed much. The fertilizer has been in
place for awhile now, but it doesn't seem to be taking
effect."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, it hasn't changed much. The fertilizer has been in
place for awhile now, but it doesn't seem to be taking
effect."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春に何かできることはないですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything I can do?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything I can do?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……特にないよ。あるとすれば、あまりここ
　に立ち入らないようにしてくれることかな」
dialogues.en:
"...Not really. People really shouldn't be around here in
the first place."
dialogues.text:
"...Not really. People really shouldn't be around here in
the first place."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ありゃりゃ、美春は嫌われてしまいましたか」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, I guess I'm not wanted..."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, I guess I'm not wanted..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「違うよ、嫌いだなんて、そんなことは」
dialogues.en: "That's not true. It's not that you're not wanted..."
dialogues.text: "That's not true. It's not that you're not wanted..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うん……。ただ、ボクはここにあまり人が来
　るようになって欲しくなかったから」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... it's just that we don't want random epople to start
dropping by."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... it's just that we don't want random epople to start
dropping by."

dialogues.jp:
月城がここを選んでいる理由の一つに、人があ
まり来ないから、というのがあると思う。
dialogues.en:
One of the reasons why Tsukishiro chose this place, was
probably because people never come here.
dialogues.text:
One of the reasons why Tsukishiro chose this place, was
probably because people never come here.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、俺や美春が度々足を運べば、何かある
のではと思う連中も出てくるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Miharu and I didn't see a single person on the way here
either.
dialogues.text:
Miharu and I didn't see a single person on the way here
either.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「で、でも、朝倉先輩や、天枷さんが来てくれ
　るのは……嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en:
"B, but, we're glad that Asakura-senpai and Amakase-san
came."
dialogues.text:
"B, but, we're glad that Asakura-senpai and Amakase-san
came."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ホントですか？」
dialogues.en: "R, really?"
dialogues.text: "R, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ボクは、ウソはつかないよ」
dialogues.en: "I don't tell lies."
dialogues.text: "I don't tell lies."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「よかった。――そうだ、バナナ食べますか？
　一緒に食べようと思って持ってきたんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"That's good. --Oh! Do you want to eat a banana? I thought
we'd eat together, so I brought lots!"
dialogues.text:
"That's good. --Oh! Do you want to eat a banana? I thought
we'd eat together, so I brought lots!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Banana?"
dialogues.text: "...Banana?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、食べたことないなんて言わないです
　よね？」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me you've never eaten one?"
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me you've never eaten one?"

dialogues.jp: おもむろに鞄の中からバナナを取り出す美春。
dialogues.en: Miharu slowly retrieved a banana from her bag.
dialogues.text: Miharu slowly retrieved a banana from her bag.

dialogues.jp:
「……お前の鞄の中は、教科書じゃなくてバナ
　ナしか入ってないんじゃないだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"...So your bag is used to hold bananas, and not textbooks,
huh."
dialogues.text:
"...So your bag is used to hold bananas, and not textbooks,
huh."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ま、まさか。ちゃんとお勉強道具も入ってま
　すよ……」
dialogues.en: "N, not true! I do bring along stuff for studying..."
dialogues.text: "N, not true! I do bring along stuff for studying..."

dialogues.jp:
微妙にうろたえた美春の顔は、あきらかにバナ
ナしか入っていない証拠だ。
dialogues.en:
The flustered expression on Miharu's face showed just how
truthful her statements were.
dialogues.text:
The flustered expression on Miharu's face showed just how
truthful her statements were.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、月城さん。……えーと、このお人形さ
　んにもあげた方がいいのかな」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, Tsukishiro-san. ...Umm, should I give one to the doll
too?"
dialogues.text:
"Okay, Tsukishiro-san. ...Umm, should I give one to the doll
too?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「さすがに、バナナは食べられないよ」
dialogues.en: "I can't exactly eat a banana."
dialogues.text: "I can't exactly eat a banana."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ですよね」
dialogues.en: "That's... true."
dialogues.text: "That's... true."

dialogues.jp:
美春が笑いながら、それでもバナナを２本差し
出していた。
dialogues.en: Laughing a little, Miharu took out two bananas from her bag.
dialogues.text: Laughing a little, Miharu took out two bananas from her bag.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、美春のバナナを受け取ると、傍らの鞄
に収めていた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro accepted one from Miharu, and put it in her bag.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro accepted one from Miharu, and put it in her bag.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
そして、ちらりとだけこちらを見た後、また草
の方だけをじーっと見始めた。
dialogues.en:
And after a quick glance at me, Tsukishiro went back to
staring at the plant.
dialogues.text:
And after a quick glance at me, Tsukishiro went back to
staring at the plant.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そばにあるブロックに腰掛けて、その様
子を眺めていた。
dialogues.en: I sat on a nearby block next to her, and did the same.
dialogues.text: I sat on a nearby block next to her, and did the same.

dialogues.jp:
横に立っていた美春が、俺の耳元に顔を寄せ、
ぼそりと｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en:
Miharu, standing beside me, then brought her mouth down to
my ear, and started to whisper.
dialogues.text:
Miharu, standing beside me, then brought her mouth down to
my ear, and started to whisper.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……先輩。月城さん、美春達が来たっていう
　のに、ずうーっとああしてるつもりなんです
　かね」
dialogues.en:
"...Senpai. Tsukishiro's just staring at that plant even
though you and I came here..."
dialogues.text:
"...Senpai. Tsukishiro's just staring at that plant even
though you and I came here..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, and?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, and?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「せっかく美春達がいるんだから、一緒にお話
　するとか、遊ぶとか」
dialogues.en:
"Since we're here, I thought we'd all talk, or do something,
or..."
dialogues.text:
"Since we're here, I thought we'd all talk, or do something,
or..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そう言ってみればいいじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "If you think so, why don't you try."
dialogues.text: "If you think so, why don't you try."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、捨てられた子犬のような目で俺を見な
がら、月城の方へ歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
Miharu, finally casting off the puppy-dog eyes she was
trying to give me, walked over to Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Miharu, finally casting off the puppy-dog eyes she was
trying to give me, walked over to Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: そして、月城に、
dialogues.en: Then, next to her,
dialogues.text: Then, next to her,

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さん、美春達と一緒にお話ししたりしま
　せんか？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san, would you like to talk with me for awhile?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san, would you like to talk with me for awhile?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ふるふると首を横に振り、人形の顔を
見せる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro simply shook her head, and glanced at her doll's
face.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro simply shook her head, and glanced at her doll's
face.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね、アリスには、こっちの花の方が大
　切なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry. This flower is really important to Alice."
dialogues.text: "Sorry. This flower is really important to Alice."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "I, I see..."
dialogues.text: "I, I see..."

dialogues.jp:
美春が、すたすたと俺のところに戻ってくる。
そして、目をウルウルとさせながら、また俺に
こっそりと囁く。
dialogues.en:
Miharu quickly walked back to me. Then, this time with a
troubled face, started whispering in my ear.
dialogues.text:
Miharu quickly walked back to me. Then, this time with a
troubled face, started whispering in my ear.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「月城さん、……美春達とは遊びたくないそう
　ですぅ〜」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-san... doesn't want to play with me~"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-san... doesn't want to play with me~"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いつもの月城を見てりゃ、わかるだろ……」
dialogues.en: "If you knew her better, you'd expect that..."
dialogues.text: "If you knew her better, you'd expect that..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃあ、そうですけど……、仲良くしたい
　じゃないですかぁ」
dialogues.en: "That's true, but... I want to be closer to her..."
dialogues.text: "That's true, but... I want to be closer to her..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、気持ちはわかるがな」
dialogues.en: "I can understand your feelings, but, well."
dialogues.text: "I can understand your feelings, but, well."

dialogues.jp:
とはいえ、確かにもうちょっと月城には心を開
いて欲しいとは思うが……、俺もどうしたらい
いのか、よくわからない。
dialogues.en:
I want Tsukishiro to open her heart more too... but I don't
know what more I can do for that to happen.
dialogues.text:
I want Tsukishiro to open her heart more too... but I don't
know what more I can do for that to happen.

dialogues.jp:
半ば強引に話しかけたりというのもアリだとは
思うけれど、たぶんそうすることがいい結果を
生むとは思えなかった。
dialogues.en:
If I try to overdo it, I might regret the consequences for
the rest of my life.
dialogues.text:
If I try to overdo it, I might regret the consequences for
the rest of my life.

dialogues.jp: なのに、突然──、
dialogues.en: And then, suddenly--
dialogues.text: And then, suddenly--

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「月城嬢！　ご機嫌はいかがかなッ？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-jou! How are you doing today?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-jou! How are you doing today?"

dialogues.jp:
茂みが大きく揺れ動き、そこから、黒い長身の
男が飛び出してくる。
dialogues.en:
From the trembling bushes, a tall man in dark clothes popped
out.
dialogues.text:
From the trembling bushes, a tall man in dark clothes popped
out.

dialogues.jp: 「なにッ！」
dialogues.en: "What the!?"
dialogues.text: "What the!?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「す、杉並先輩……」
dialogues.en: "S, Suginami-senpai..."
dialogues.text: "S, Suginami-senpai..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、俺達の方を見て、にやりと笑い、月城
の前に立った。
dialogues.en:
Suginami grinned at us, then went to stand in front of
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Suginami grinned at us, then went to stand in front of
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「相変わらず、花の世話か。しかし、それだけ
　では毎日がつまらないだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Still taking care of that flower, as usual. But doesn't
that get boring, doing it every day?"
dialogues.text:
"Still taking care of that flower, as usual. But doesn't
that get boring, doing it every day?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、何しに来たんだ」
dialogues.en: "Why did you come here?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you come here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺か？　俺は、月城嬢に腹話術のやり方を教
　わろうと思ってな」
dialogues.en:
"Me? I was wondering whether Tsukishiro-jou could teach me a
little something about ventriloquism."
dialogues.text:
"Me? I was wondering whether Tsukishiro-jou could teach me a
little something about ventriloquism."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「腹話術？」
dialogues.en: "Ventriloquism?"
dialogues.text: "Ventriloquism?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「先日見た、月城嬢の素晴らしい腹話術を見て
　ぜひ、俺もその技術を学びたいという訳だ」
dialogues.en:
"Having experienced Tsukishiro's mastery of the technique
yesterday, I desire to learn that splendid skill as well.
dialogues.text:
"Having experienced Tsukishiro's mastery of the technique
yesterday, I desire to learn that splendid skill as well.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は『人形もちゃんと持ってきた』と言い、
カバンから、パンダの人形を取り出した。
dialogues.en:
Saying that "I've brought a doll too!", he revealed a panda
doll from within his bag.
dialogues.text:
Saying that "I've brought a doll too!", he revealed a panda
doll from within his bag.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「白と黒のツートンがチャームポイント。ホン
　トは凶悪な野獣、パンダちゃんだッ！」
dialogues.en:
"It's white and black skin are it's biggest charm, and it's
actually a ferocious monster in disguise. It's Panda-chan!"
dialogues.text:
"It's white and black skin are it's biggest charm, and it's
actually a ferocious monster in disguise. It's Panda-chan!"

dialogues.jp:
パンダの人形を腕にはめ、パクパクと口を動か
す杉並。
dialogues.en:
As he moved it's arm up and down, the mouth on the panda
doll started moving as well.
dialogues.text:
As he moved it's arm up and down, the mouth on the panda
doll started moving as well.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「こんにちわ。ボク、パンダのジョニーウルフ。
　よろしくね」
dialogues.en:
"Good afternoon! My name is Johnny Wolf, the panda! Nice to
meet you."
dialogues.text:
"Good afternoon! My name is Johnny Wolf, the panda! Nice to
meet you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「めっちゃお前が喋ってるじゃないか！」
dialogues.en: "It's so obvious that it's you talking!"
dialogues.text: "It's so obvious that it's you talking!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「パンダなのに、ウルフって……」
dialogues.en: "A panda, called Wolf..."
dialogues.text: "A panda, called Wolf..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うまく喋れないから、月城嬢に指南を仰ぎに
　きたんじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"Exactly, and that is why I have come to partake in
Tsukishiro-jou's tutelage!"
dialogues.text:
"Exactly, and that is why I have come to partake in
Tsukishiro-jou's tutelage!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、月城にパンダを突きつけ、パクパクと
口を動かす。
dialogues.en:
Suginami thrust the panda in front of Tsukishiro, and
started moving it's mouth again.
dialogues.text:
Suginami thrust the panda in front of Tsukishiro, and
started moving it's mouth again.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さあ、ボクにピロスキーの技を教えてよ。ボ
　クもうまく喋りたいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Please, teach me Pirosuki's skills. I want to be able to
talk too!"
dialogues.text:
"Please, teach me Pirosuki's skills. I want to be able to
talk too!"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、杉並から顔を背けようとするが、人形
が口を開く。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro turned her face away from him, and the doll's
mouth opened again.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro turned her face away from him, and the doll's
mouth opened again.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ピロスキーじゃない。ピ・ロ・ス！　名前く
　らいちゃんと覚えてよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not Pirosuki, I'm PIROS! Remember that name!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not Pirosuki, I'm PIROS! Remember that name!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「覚えている。ちゃんと覚えているとも、ピロ
　スキー」
dialogues.en: "I remember you. How could I forget, Pirosuki?"
dialogues.text: "I remember you. How could I forget, Pirosuki?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「覚えてないよッ。それに、ボクは腹話術なん
　かじゃない。そんなパンダと一緒にしないで」
dialogues.en:
"You don't! And I'm not some tool for ventriloquism, don't
put me together with that panda!"
dialogues.text:
"You don't! And I'm not some tool for ventriloquism, don't
put me together with that panda!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「パンダじゃダメか……。では、これならどう
　だ、双子のタヌキ、シズマとスケキヨ！」
dialogues.en:
"So a panda can't do it... then how about this, twin
raccoons, Shizuma and Sukekiyo!"
dialogues.text:
"So a panda can't do it... then how about this, twin
raccoons, Shizuma and Sukekiyo!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「タヌキでも、キツネでも、違うったら、違う
　の！　先輩は……」
dialogues.en:
"Raccoons, foxes, whatever, you're completely wrong!
It's..."
dialogues.text:
"Raccoons, foxes, whatever, you're completely wrong!
It's..."

dialogues.jp:
月城が手袋をはめた時点で人形が突然喋らなく
なる。
dialogues.en:
As soon as Tsukishiro put her gloves back on, the doll
immediately became lifeless again.
dialogues.text:
As soon as Tsukishiro put her gloves back on, the doll
immediately became lifeless again.

dialogues.jp: そして、むりやり声を絞り出すかのように、
dialogues.en: Then, forcing the words out of her pained mouth,
dialogues.text: Then, forcing the words out of her pained mouth,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ご、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I, I'm very sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I, I'm very sorry."

dialogues.jp: とぺこりと頭を下げ、その場を離れてしまった。
dialogues.en: And with a bow, ran off.
dialogues.text: And with a bow, ran off.

dialogues.jp: 杉並が｛あぜん／唖然｝として、その場に立ちつくす。
dialogues.en: Suginami was left standing there, dumbfounded.
dialogues.text: Suginami was left standing there, dumbfounded.

dialogues.jp: 「……なにやってんだよ、お前は」
dialogues.en: "...What the hell were you doing."
dialogues.text: "...What the hell were you doing."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうやら、逆効果だったようだな……」
dialogues.en: "It appears the plan backfired..."
dialogues.text: "It appears the plan backfired..."

dialogues.jp:
手にパンダとタヌキをはめたままの杉並が、爽
やかな笑顔で髪をかきあげる。
dialogues.en:
Putting back the panda and raccoons, he combed his hair with
his hands, laughing.
dialogues.text:
Putting back the panda and raccoons, he combed his hair with
his hands, laughing.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「逆効果じゃないですよぅ。美春達が一生懸命
　月城さんと仲良くなろうと思ってるのに」
dialogues.en:
"It didn't just backfire! We've been trying so hard to get
closer to her..."
dialogues.text:
"It didn't just backfire! We've been trying so hard to get
closer to her..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ嬢……。俺だって同じ気持ちだ」
dialogues.en: "My dear puppy... I hold the same feelings."
dialogues.text: "My dear puppy... I hold the same feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうだか」
dialogues.en: "No way."
dialogues.text: "No way."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「俺も美春に同感だな」
dialogues.en: "I agree with Miharu."
dialogues.text: "I agree with Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ。困ったものだな、お前達にも」
dialogues.en: "Tsk tsk. You two are so worrisome."
dialogues.text: "Tsk tsk. You two are so worrisome."

dialogues.jp:
パペット人形の形をした手でそんなことを言わ
れても、こっちが困る。
dialogues.en:
When you're holding two different types of puppets like
that, who wouldn't be?"
dialogues.text:
When you're holding two different types of puppets like
that, who wouldn't be?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「腹話術なり本当にピロスキーが喋ってるなり、
　月城嬢があの人形を使ってでしか会話ができ
　ていないのは本当のことだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Whether it's ventriloquism, whether Pirosuki actually
talks, the fact is, Tsukishiro-jou converses through that
doll, no?"
dialogues.text:
"Whether it's ventriloquism, whether Pirosuki actually
talks, the fact is, Tsukishiro-jou converses through that
doll, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、確かにな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, that is right..."
dialogues.text: "Well, that is right..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それを、俺がどうにかしてやろうと！」
dialogues.en: "And that's exactly what I want to learn!"
dialogues.text: "And that's exactly what I want to learn!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……それで逃げられた、と」
dialogues.en: "...And she ran away."
dialogues.text: "...And she ran away."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ったく。これじゃあ腹話術のテクを聞くこと
　ができないじゃないか！」
dialogues.en:
"Tsk. At this rate, I won't be able to learn the true
techniques of ventriloquism!"
dialogues.text:
"Tsk. At this rate, I won't be able to learn the true
techniques of ventriloquism!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「って、目的はそこかい」
dialogues.en: "So that's your motive."
dialogues.text: "So that's your motive."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「最近は不景気でな。芸は身を助けるなどと言
　うだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Times have been tough. During a recession like this, taking
up an art might be the only thing that can save your soul."
dialogues.text:
"Times have been tough. During a recession like this, taking
up an art might be the only thing that can save your soul."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前にしちゃ、えらくおとなしい発言だな…」
dialogues.en: "You just be quiet..."
dialogues.text: "You just be quiet..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？　たまにはいいだろう？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Isn't it good once in awhile?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Isn't it good once in awhile?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、杉並先輩は美春の前に、姿を現わ
　すなんて無防備すぎやしませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, just showing up in front of me, isn't that
awfully defenseless of you, Suginami-senpai?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, just showing up in front of me, isn't that
awfully defenseless of you, Suginami-senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「仮にも卒業式前のこの時期に……風紀委員の
　前にノコノコと……」
dialogues.en:
"During this time of the graduation party preparations...
just wandering around in front of a discplinary committee
member...
dialogues.text:
"During this time of the graduation party preparations...
just wandering around in front of a discplinary committee
member...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、そう言えば、そうだったな……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, now that is true..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, now that is true..."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が美春を見て、にやにやと笑う。
dialogues.en: Suginami changed his target to Miharu, smirking.
dialogues.text: Suginami changed his target to Miharu, smirking.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「う〜っ、う〜っ」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, uh oh..."
dialogues.text: "Uhh, uh oh..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、俺の『卒業パーティーで素敵な腹話術を
　披露して卒業生に楽しんでもらおう作戦』は、
　これでダメになったし……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, my plan for a "Graduation Party Ventriloquism Super
Contest For Your Enjoyment!" event seems to be in
shambles..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, my plan for a "Graduation Party Ventriloquism Super
Contest For Your Enjoyment!" event seems to be in
shambles..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「う、ウソだぁ、そんな計画だった訳ないじゃ
　ないですかぁ」
dialogues.en: "Y, you're lying! You never had such a plan in mind!"
dialogues.text: "Y, you're lying! You never had such a plan in mind!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふふッ、信じる信じないは、わんこ嬢次第だ。
　それでは、また会おう」
dialogues.en:
"Haha, believe it or not, that's up to you, my dear puppy.
We will meet again!"
dialogues.text:
"Haha, believe it or not, that's up to you, my dear puppy.
We will meet again!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、そう言うと同胞のパンダとタヌキをカ
バンの中に詰め込む。
dialogues.en:
While talking, he stuffed his fellow panda and raccoons into
his bag.
dialogues.text:
While talking, he stuffed his fellow panda and raccoons into
his bag.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ、朝倉。例の件、１６時に屋上でな」
dialogues.en:
"And Asakura. About you-know-what, be at the rooftop at 1600
hours."
dialogues.text:
"And Asakura. About you-know-what, be at the rooftop at 1600
hours."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「は？　何のことだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hah? What're you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Hah? What're you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、妙な捨てぜりふを残して、茂みの中に
消えていく。
dialogues.en:
Throwing those words at me, he then disappeared into the
bushes.
dialogues.text:
Throwing those words at me, he then disappeared into the
bushes.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉先輩。今の杉並先輩の台詞、どうい
　う意味ですか？　１６時に屋上で、何の話を
　する気ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Asakura-senpai, what did Suginami mean just now? What
will you be talking about at 1600 hours on the rooftop?"
dialogues.text:
"...Asakura-senpai, what did Suginami mean just now? What
will you be talking about at 1600 hours on the rooftop?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺は関係ない！　杉並が俺をはめよう
　としてるだけだ！　俺は何もやらないんだっ
　てば……！」
dialogues.en:
"I, it's got nothign to do with me! Suginami's just trying
to frame me! I didn't do anyth...!"
dialogues.text:
"I, it's got nothign to do with me! Suginami's just trying
to frame me! I didn't do anyth...!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「バナナボンバーッ！！！」
dialogues.en: "BANANAAAA BOMBERRRR!"
dialogues.text: "BANANAAAA BOMBERRRR!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「って、なんだ、その技はァーーーッ！！」
dialogues.en: "W, what the hell is thaaaaaaat~~~!!"
dialogues.text: "W, what the hell is thaaaaaaat~~~!!"

dialogues.jp:
なんにせよ、月城と俺達が仲良くなるまでには
もう少し時間がかかりそうだ。
dialogues.en:
It seems no matter what, Tsukishiro will need more time
before we can get closer to her.
dialogues.text:
It seems no matter what, Tsukishiro will need more time
before we can get closer to her.

dialogues.jp:
彼女のことについて、もう少し何かわかればい
いんだけど。
dialogues.en: There's still so much I don't know about her, but.
dialogues.text: There's still so much I don't know about her, but.

dialogues.jp:
バナナボンバーの内容と威力は、各人の想像に
おまかせする。
dialogues.en:
I certainly know the full extent of the Banana Bomber's
destructive power now.
dialogues.text:
I certainly know the full extent of the Banana Bomber's
destructive power now.

dialogues.jp: ◆シズマとスケキヨ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Shizuma And Sukekiyo◆
dialogues.text: ◆Shizuma And Sukekiyo◆

dialogues.jp: 俺は、昨日に続いて、月城の様子を見に来た。
dialogues.en:
Following up form yesterday, I went to see how Alice was
doing.
dialogues.text:
Following up form yesterday, I went to see how Alice was
doing.

dialogues.jp:
途中、美春に出会い、面倒くさいことになった
と思ったが、どうやら美春も同じ目的で、月城
の様子を見に行くところだったようだ。
dialogues.en:
On the way, I ran into Miharu, who started asking about
troublesome things, but she had the same objective; to see
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
On the way, I ran into Miharu, who started asking about
troublesome things, but she had the same objective; to see
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりして、月城の所に行き、せっかくだから
遊ぼうと声をかけたりしたのだが、月城はその
場から動こうとはしなかった。
dialogues.en:
We went together to the usual place. Miharu called her out
to do something since they all were here, but she refused to
move from her observation spot.
dialogues.text:
We went together to the usual place. Miharu called her out
to do something since they all were here, but she refused to
move from her observation spot.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、今までがそうだったから、今さらといっ
たところなのだが。
dialogues.en:
Well, it's been like this all the while, hard to expect
anything differnt.
dialogues.text:
Well, it's been like this all the while, hard to expect
anything differnt.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、問題は、その後、杉並が乱入してきた
ことだ。
dialogues.en:
The bigger problem was afte, when Suginami intruded once
again.
dialogues.text:
The bigger problem was afte, when Suginami intruded once
again.

dialogues.jp:
ヤツは、奇妙なぬいぐるみを持ち出し、月城に
腹話術を教えてくれと、どう考えてもおもしろ
がってやっているような行動に出た。
dialogues.en:
Holding several strange... things... he appeared to come
here to convince Tsukishiro to teach him ventriloquism.
dialogues.text:
Holding several strange... things... he appeared to come
here to convince Tsukishiro to teach him ventriloquism.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくは、月城も人形で応戦していたが、結
局最後は、杉並のせいで、逃げ出してしまった。
dialogues.en:
Despite his many attempts at cajoling her into action, she
eventually decided to run away.
dialogues.text:
Despite his many attempts at cajoling her into action, she
eventually decided to run away.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、自分も月城と仲良くなりたいのだと言
うのだが、どうにもうさんくさい。
dialogues.en:
He tried to make us believe that he just wanted to get
closer to Tsukishiro, but who would?
dialogues.text:
He tried to make us believe that he just wanted to get
closer to Tsukishiro, but who would?

dialogues.jp:
ただ、自分の言葉ではなく、人形を使って喋っ
ている月城をなんとかしてやろうと思っている
のだと意味深なこともいうのだった。
dialogues.en:
The fact that she never talks, and makes a doll talk for
her, seems to hint towards some deep meaning that he's
interested in.
dialogues.text:
The fact that she never talks, and makes a doll talk for
her, seems to hint towards some deep meaning that he's
interested in.

dialogues.jp:
いったい、杉並の本意がどこにあるのかわから
ないが、困ったヤツであることには変わりない。
dialogues.en:
I have no clue what Suginami wishes to achieve, but more
importantly, he's something I have to be careful of.
dialogues.text:
I have no clue what Suginami wishes to achieve, but more
importantly, he's something I have to be careful of.
